verdict.rationale: Mem0 Platform explicitly builds a native graph linking entities, places, and concepts across memories with no external graph database required, directly supporting multi-hop and entity-centric queries like what do we know about Alice. Docs describe automatic graph construction without schema definition, replacing earlier Neo4j-based integration. missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of graph memory multi-hop retrieval accuracy, and no benchmark showing entity-relationship correctness
